title: Python DIO serializer validates mutable options before re-reading them
description: python/src/lichen/rpl/messages.py validates DIO Rule-Version cardinality over live mutable DIO/RplOption objects, then iterates/re-reads the same caller-owned options again during encoding. Stateful iterables or concurrent mutation can pass one valid 0x13 option during validation and serialize duplicates/malformed data or changed scalar role/rank afterward. Snapshot every scalar and deep-copy exact option primitives once, validate and encode only the immutable snapshot, rejecting alias tricks. Add stateful-iterator and mutation-barrier tests with unchanged canonical vectors.
notes: Implemented exact DIO scalar/option snapshot serialization in rpl/messages.py with stateful-list, mutable encoder, alias, mutable-data, and mutated-scalar tests. Focused RPL tests green; leave open for independent convergence.
